response.goal: Connect a few of their tools using automation.

plan.step: Kickoff and discovery call to identify the tools that need to be connected and map out the required workflows.
Design and build the integration workflows based on the shared tool details.
Test the automations with sample data to ensure reliable execution and error handling.
Handover and review of the completed integrations with the client.

milestones.name: Discovery and Architecture
milestones.deliverable: Detailed integration plan and confirmed list of tools to connect.

milestones.name: Build and Test
milestones.deliverable: Functional automation workflows tested and verified.
